recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the work group later chooses a stricter rule for base-less root StructureDefinitions.
issue_request: FHIR-20403 was a Published FHIR Infrastructure change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that StructureDefinition.derivation be mandatory or otherwise validated because missing derivation makes a StructureDefinition with a baseDefinition ambiguous. The accepted resolution was to add the invariant baseDefinition.exists() implies derivation.exists().
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20403 was found. Commit eefb19aee666980d9efede00670c6ce795820c8b added sdf-27 to StructureDefinition with expression baseDefinition.exists() implies derivation.exists(), and later reformatting retained it.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition in the active [resources] section, placing source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml in current build scope. StructureDefinition.derivation remains min=0 but carries condition sdf-27, preserving the base-less root-structure exception discussed in Jira while enforcing derivation whenever baseDefinition exists. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because sdf-27 is present and linked from both StructureDefinition.baseDefinition and StructureDefinition.derivation; changing derivation to unconditional 1..1 would be broader than the approved modified resolution.
